what: A full-screen hero photo slot is scrubbed to scroll and folds down via Flip.fit into the small slot (16:10, text height .73em) inside the large heading line just below. That slot then opens from width 0 to its full width, pushing the heading words apart to either side. It starts when the photo slot’s center reaches the screen center and ends when the heading slot’s center reaches 35% of the screen. With several slots, it passes through them in turn and splits the length by the distance (px) between slots. Once movement starts, add-ons such as the photo credit switch off

duration.Cell gap: Proportional to the distance (px) between the two cells

options.slot: Cell to fold into (selector). Required. If there are several, they are processed in document order. In the original it is an inline-block 16:10 cell inside the title, height .73em.
options.grow: If off, cell width is not expanded from 0, default on
options.hide: Turns off once movement starts (selector, optional) — photo credit

use: Work Title, Place
note: The original passes the curve name base.inOut, but it is an unregistered name, so it runs with the GSAP default (power1.out) — that actual behavior is kept as the default. The start box is the element’s parent (the full-screen stage). Since line breaks can change as the box width opens up from 0, each re-measure (refreshInit) resets to the initial state and then refits.

from.where: detail.html .e-dh (original HeroProject — data-target fits to each data-zone in turn with Flip.fit, start center center · endTrigger is the last cell, end center 35% · scrub true, from cell width 0, progress > 0 means source opacity 0)
